watch one's weight: My mother has been watching her weight, so she eats more vegetables and skips desserts after dinner.
我媽媽一直在注意體重，所以她多吃蔬菜，晚餐後也不吃甜點。
watch one's step: The stairs in this old temple are steep and wet, so please watch your step as you go down.
這座老廟的階梯又陡又濕，所以下樓時請小心腳步。
watch one's language: There are young children in the room, so please watch your language and stop using those rude words.
房間裡有小孩子，所以請注意你的用語，別再說那些粗話了。
watch out for: When you ride a bike in the city, you should always watch out for cars turning at corners.
在城市裡騎腳踏車時，你應該隨時當心在轉角轉彎的車輛。
watch over: While the parents went shopping, their grandmother stayed home to watch over the sleeping baby.
父母去購物時，奶奶留在家裡看顧正在睡覺的嬰兒。
watch the clock: On the last day before summer vacation, every student in class kept watching the clock and waiting for the bell.
暑假前的最後一天，班上每個學生都一直盯著時鐘等下課鐘響。
watch one's back: People say the new manager likes to blame others, so you had better watch your back at work.
大家說新經理喜歡怪罪別人，所以你在工作上最好提防一點。
water down a proposal: Under pressure from big companies, the lawmakers decided to water down a proposal to cut air pollution.
在大公司的壓力下，立法委員決定弱化一項減少空氣污染的提案。
water down the truth: The news report tried to water down the truth about the accident so that people would not panic.
這則新聞報導試圖淡化這起事故的事實，以免民眾恐慌。
water the plants: While we are on vacation, our neighbor has agreed to water the plants on our balcony every morning.
我們去度假期間，鄰居答應每天早上幫我們陽台上的植物澆水。
mouth waters: Every time I walk past the bakery and smell fresh bread, my mouth waters and I want to buy some.
每次我經過麵包店聞到新鮮麵包的香味，就會流口水想買一些。
eyes water: Whenever my father cuts onions in the kitchen, his eyes water and he has to stop for a moment.
每當我爸爸在廚房切洋蔥，他就會流眼淚，必須停下來一下。
water under the bridge: We had a big fight in junior high, but that is water under the bridge now, and we are close friends.
我們國中時大吵過一次，但那已經是過去的事了，現在我們是好朋友。
wave goodbye: As the train slowly left the station, the little girl kept waving goodbye to her grandparents on the platform.
火車緩緩駛離車站時，小女孩一直向月台上的祖父母揮手道別。
wave aside objections: The boss was so sure of his plan that he waved aside objections from everyone at the meeting.
老闆對他的計畫非常有把握，以至於對會議上每個人的反對都置之不理。
wave through a bill: With little discussion, the city council decided to wave through a bill that raised parking fees downtown.
幾乎沒有討論，市議會就決定快速通過一項調漲市區停車費的法案。
wave someone off: The whole family went to the airport to wave someone off who was leaving to study in Canada.
全家人到機場去，為一位要去加拿大留學的人揮手送別。
wave a flag: At the baseball game, thousands of fans waved a flag and cheered loudly whenever our team scored.
在棒球比賽中，每當我們的隊伍得分，數千名球迷就揮旗大聲歡呼。
make waves: She is new at the company and does not want to make waves by criticizing the old rules too soon.
她剛進公司，不想太早批評舊規定而興風作浪。
ride the wave: After her first song became popular online, the singer decided to ride the wave and release a new album quickly.
她的第一首歌在網路上走紅後，這位歌手決定乘勢趕快推出新專輯。
wax lyrical about: My uncle always waxes lyrical about the beautiful mountains in Hualien whenever he talks about his childhood.
每當我叔叔談起他的童年，總會對花蓮美麗的山滔滔不絕地讚美。
wax and wane: Interest in the sport seems to wax and wane, depending on how well the national team is doing.
人們對這項運動的興趣似乎時盛時衰，取決於國家隊表現得好不好。
wax the floor: The cleaners came on Sunday to wax the floor of the hall, so now it is shiny but a little slippery.
清潔人員週日來為大廳地板打蠟，所以現在地板很亮，但有點滑。
wax poetic: When the old man began to wax poetic about his first love, everyone at the table listened quietly.
當老先生開始大發詩興談起他的初戀時，桌邊的每個人都安靜地聆聽。
weaken the economy: Economists fear that the long trade war will weaken the economy and cause many people to lose their jobs.
經濟學家擔心這場長期的貿易戰會削弱經濟，導致許多人失業。
weaken one's resolve: Don't let the smell of fried chicken weaken your resolve to eat healthy food during your diet.
別讓炸雞的香味動搖你在減重期間吃健康食物的決心。
the dollar weakened: After the bad news about jobs came out, the dollar weakened against the yen for the third day in a row.
在不佳的就業消息公布後，美元兌日圓連續第三天走弱。
weaken the argument: Using numbers that are ten years old will only weaken the argument in your essay, so find newer data.
使用十年前的數字只會削弱你論文中的論點，所以要找更新的資料。
weaken one's position: The player's injury will slightly weaken his position on the team when the coach chooses the starters.
這名球員的傷勢在教練挑選先發球員時，會稍微削弱他在隊上的地位。
weaken the immune system: Doctors say that a lack of sleep can weaken the immune system and make you catch colds more easily.
醫生說睡眠不足會削弱免疫系統，讓你更容易感冒。
